purpose: Verify that an actually observed V witness can condition a real G replacement request after KRC v0.2's spontaneous first 10 outputs triggered zero repairs.
model: Same frozen Qwen3-0.6B Q8 GGUF and llama.cpp commit as KRC v0.2
injection_policy: Each first invalid candidate is supplied by the stress harness, NOT claimed as model-generated. Critic must independently detect its declared defect. One actual Qwen request per injected case receives only source context and V-produced defect codes.

injected_candidate.sentence: 20분 뒤 감싼 병의 물 온도가 7도 낮았다.
화자는 아쉬운 마음으로 서점 문 밖 인도에 서 있었다.

success_definition: For each case, original injected candidate is mechanically rejected with required witness and one subsequent real model output is evaluated as pass/fail independently. A pass does not establish semantic equivalence.
comparison: Not comparable to unsolicited error frequency or naturalness effect in KRC v0.1/v0.2. Controlled injected errors are not a random sample of model errors.
